title: Autoroute Patterns: Generate URLs With Liquid | Orchard Core
description:
Every content item needs a URL, and typing each one by hand does not scale.

The Autoroute part generates the URL from a Liquid pattern that you write once on the content type. This video shows what a pattern can use, when it runs, how to edit it in the admin and set it in code, and how to load content by its URL.

In this video:
• How a pattern works: from a Liquid expression to a URL
• What a pattern can use: the content item, filters and fields
• Edit a pattern on a content type
• The paths a pattern generates
• A pattern with a container
• Patterns in a migration and in a recipe
• Find content by its URL in Liquid and Razor
